en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside or coastal scene with small houses among trees and several boats pulled up on the shore. In the background stands a large triangular-gabled stone ruin of a church or monastery. A person rows a small boat in the foreground water. In the upper left corner there is a circular emblem with text surrounding a stylized drawing of the same ruin. The caption "Pirita" appears below the image.
